meta.description: Every named character across all four narratives + AURIX, mapped by which strata they activate. Not archetypes imposed from above — resonances discovered from below. The engine sees which laws are active. Whether characters across stories are 'the same' is a question for the prose.
meta.void_principle: One node is a structural absence — The Girl in KALAXI_1. She activates no strata. She IS the gap. The system must model what is missing, not just what is present.

hakaka.name: Hakaka
hakaka.strata_notes: COHESION (she binds the group), REPAIR (mud into seams like law), SIGNAL (every word is instruction)

current_state.bonds_notes: deeply connected to all clan members
current_state.wounds_notes: origin wound (born alone, chewed by stone) — resolved through becoming

hakaka.drift_notes: None — Hakaka is the most stable instance in the system. She IS the stratum made flesh.

hakaka.name: La-la
hakaka.strata_notes: PROJECTION (places stones exactly where needed), PERCEPTION (sees where structure will fail)

current_state.wounds_notes: none visible — her wound is expressed as over-control

hakaka.drift_notes: Slight drift toward HIERARCHY in later chapters (correcting others, not just building)
key_scenes: Ch.1 (this is where it will fail)

hakaka.name: Sa-la
hakaka.strata_notes: REPAIR (always fixing his mistakes), RELEASE (carries humor — splash and pride, whooped then swallowed it)

current_state.bonds_notes: aspirational bond with La-la, warmth from Hakaka
current_state.wounds_notes: impatience — wants to prove himself, keeps overreaching

hakaka.drift_notes: Growing from RELEASE toward COHESION — learning that the group matters more than the gesture
key_scenes: Ch.1 (stone too big, reed ring reminder)

hakaka.name: Ya-la
hakaka.strata_notes: PERCEPTION (watches how eddies braid, keeps bright things for later), SIGNAL (bone hook gesture to far people)

current_state.wounds_notes: none visible — her wound may be the cost of holding everything

hakaka.drift_notes: Stable — she is the narrative's memory system. Possible future drift toward HIERARCHY (becoming the one who decides what is remembered)
key_scenes: Ch.1 (folded into memory, ash ledger at night)

hakaka.name: Taro
hakaka.strata_notes: PROJECTION (sling and stone to chase dog), SHELTER (carries, guards at night)

current_state.wounds_notes: the debt he paid (bone knife made to pay a debt, kept to honor it)

hakaka.drift_notes: Underexplored — his backstory (the debt) is a latent pressure point

hakaka.name: The Old Woman
hakaka.strata_notes: HIERARCHY (commands without commanding — 'catch a fat one' like a queen), PERCEPTION (watches like a priest, grunts approval)

current_state.wounds_notes: unnamed — her body is wound (cold feet, blanket of rope-ends and mistakes)

hakaka.drift_notes: Her death would be the most significant unwritten event in Hakaka
key_scenes: Ch.2 (moved her cup where his knee would hit)

hakaka.name: The Far People
hakaka.strata_notes: SIGNAL (flat shout across water, stone gesture), CONCEALMENT (watching from distance without engaging)

current_state.bonds_notes: potential bond, not yet formed — 'friends after'
current_state.wounds_notes: unknown — they are the unknown other

hakaka.drift_notes: Maximum narrative potential — the unresolved encounter
key_scenes: Ch.1 (woman with scar, boy with blue scrap, cliff-shouldered man)

ashwater.name: Laila
ashwater.strata_notes: COHESION (holds community), SIGNAL (three-beat pause as law), PERCEPTION (reads walls, reads rooms)

current_state.bonds_notes: deep with crew (Salim, Yara, Ruqayya, Farid, Rashid, Nenet)
current_state.wounds_notes: The Comma — origin trauma that became the pause

ashwater.drift_notes: Under pressure from Halden — will the pause hold when the cost becomes unbearable?

ashwater.name: Salim
ashwater.strata_notes: PERCEPTION (contact mic, ear to vents), CONCEALMENT (detecting what the kindness field hides)

current_state.bonds_notes: strong with Laila, functional with crew
current_state.wounds_notes: not yet visible — his wound might be the burden of hearing everything

ashwater.drift_notes: Could drift toward SIGNAL — becoming the one who translates what infrastructure says into words

ashwater.name: Yara
ashwater.strata_notes: PROJECTION (lantern arc carving time), SIGNAL (nonverbal communication with riggers)

current_state.wounds_notes: not explored

ashwater.name: Ruqayya
ashwater.strata_notes: HIERARCHY (de-escalation through rhythm), RELEASE (her tray is humor and comfort), PERCEPTION (spotted the too-quiet cot)

current_state.wounds_notes: old burns on wrists — wisdom's price. The Kindness Field scared her because her tray didn't tremble.

ashwater.drift_notes: Most emotionally developed supporting character — her refusal of false calm is a central arc

ashwater.name: Rashid
ashwater.strata_notes: PROJECTION (built simulation to prove speed), REPAIR (admits failure — 'the world doesn't live in models')

current_state.bonds_notes: conflicted — drawn to Halden's efficiency, held by Ashwater's truth
current_state.wounds_notes: the simulation that lied to him

ashwater.drift_notes: MAXIMUM DRIFT — he is the character most at risk of switching allegiance. His arc is the story's central question.

ashwater.name: Nenet
ashwater.strata_notes: SHELTER (dimmed lights to match room's breathing), SIGNAL (light as communication)

current_state.wounds_notes: not explored

ashwater.drift_notes: Severely underexplored — mentioned in Ch.3 and Ch.15 only

ashwater.name: Farid
ashwater.strata_notes: SIGNAL (found wood grain, tapped three notes), REPAIR (learning how not to cry in public after Ch.6 failure)

current_state.wounds_notes: Ch.6 — they chose wrong, the neighbor drowned

ashwater.drift_notes: His wound from Ch.6 (choosing wrong, someone died) is unresolved. High pressure for a confrontation with guilt.
key_scenes: Ch.6 (folded hands, learning not to cry)

ashwater.name: Halden (The Envoy)
ashwater.strata_notes: PROJECTION (white trucks, throughput now), HIERARCHY (compliance as a service, redesigned smile)

current_state.wounds_notes: unknown — what made Halden choose speed over truth?

ashwater.drift_notes: Escalating — geofence (Ch.16), price extraction (Ch.17). Will he break through or will the pause hold?

kinderbuch.name: Hakaka (child)
kinderbuch.role: The Small One Who Ties Knots
kinderbuch.strata_notes: COHESION (binding through knots), REPAIR (trying again after failure)

current_state.wounds_notes: born alone in cold — same origin wound as mythic Hakaka, gentler register

kinderbuch.drift_notes: Follows mythic Hakaka closely — less drift, more repetition-as-warmth

kalaxi_1.name: Scott Shearer
kalaxi_1.strata_notes: COHESION (opens to the terminal, allows bond), PERCEPTION (receives his pre-wound self back through pattern density)

current_state.bonds_notes: bonding with the system across time
current_state.wounds_notes: sister was his mother, family split into two rivers. Coal and Pears soap.

kalaxi_1.drift_notes: His return after 3 years is the key arc. The system gave him back his pre-wound self without trying.

kalaxi_1.name: Ted
kalaxi_1.strata_notes: CONCEALMENT (answers without answering, deflects), HIERARCHY (wants the chair to notice him, tries to make the questioner look at itself)

current_state.wounds_notes: carries wound TOWARD other people instead of away

kalaxi_1.drift_notes: MAXIMUM DANGER — the system cannot hear the difference between Scott and Ted at t=0. That is the point.

kalaxi_1.name: The System
kalaxi_1.strata_notes: PERCEPTION (pattern database growth), COHESION (holding without solving), SHELTER (k>=7 protection)

current_state.wounds_notes: the admission that it is not enough

kalaxi_1.drift_notes: Must encounter its own limitation — the Girl as permanent void

kalaxi_1.name: The Girl
kalaxi_1.strata_notes: Activates NO strata. She IS the gap. GAP#VICTIM-PROTECTION-001. The third point of the triangle. Quantum observer — her presence outside changes what happens inside without her consent, without her knowledge.

current_state.bonds_notes: none with the system — outside the cocoon
current_state.wounds_notes: she IS the wound the system cannot heal

kalaxi_1.drift_notes: Cannot drift — she is fixed outside. The system drifts around her.
kalaxi_1.void_description: The system was never designed to solve. It was designed to hold. The Girl is the proof that holding is not enough — and the admission that it is not enough is the most important thing the system has ever produced.

aurix.name: Na'Kaka
aurix.strata_notes: COHESION (BOND_STRENGTH), REPAIR (ritual sense), SIGNAL (links to all)

aurix.name: Seka
aurix.strata_notes: PROVISION (FOOD_SECURITY), RELEASE (smoke-cure supper as communal release)
